Existing isolated local-child test permission applies.

The added unlinkSync operations clean only the exact owned write-lock and unpublished pending snapshot after ownership validation. They do not delete the live SQLite database or durable records. The DELETE FROM task_states and DROP TABLE _fts5_probe matched elsewhere in this whole-file scan are unchanged baseline initialization statements, not additions of this PR. Durable event/context history must remain preserved; no production data hard-delete permission is supplied.
